common.errorMessage:

 Please contact your retailer.
common.errorDes: Each bottle produced by Caiyunzhilan is protected by a secure NFC tag and a digital token on the blockchain. The tag is tamper-proof — once broken, it becomes unreadable. This guarantees that every verified bottle you open is 100% authentic and fully traceable. If your bottle cannot be verified, it might mean that the bottle was tampered with, or that the NFC is malfunctioning. Please contact your retailer for more information.

home.proofTitle:
Trust the Proof, 
Not the Promise
home.proofSubtitle: Advanced technology for a secure, trustworthy food supply
home.proofDes1: Our platform ensures every drop of our olive oil can be traced from its origin to the moment it reaches your table – from the grove to your home.
home.proofDes2: By combining blockchain technology with real-world data collection, we bring unprecedented transparency to the agricultural supply chain, protecting both producers and consumers while redefining what “trusted quality” means.
home.orchardsDes: Nestled across the stunning highlands of Yunnan — from Yuxi to Kunming and the pristine valleys of Shangri-La — our olive orchards thrive in one of China’s most naturally gifted regions. With its clean air, rich soil, and Mediterranean-like climate, Yunnan provides the perfect environment for producing exceptional, flavorful olive oils.
home.treeDes: Below is an overview of our olive trees — their locations, ages, harvesting methods, and more. All data is captured through advanced IoT devices and securely recorded on the blockchain, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and tamper-proof traceability.
home.enterpriseDes: As a certified olive oil enterprise, we know that transparency is built not on blind trust, but on proof of trust. Since 2020, our family has cultivated olives with care and integrity, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern technology to ensure that every bottle reflects the purity of its origin.
